summary: Wires of the user's e-bike battery model (a52.solidcraft, v2), built with its Pipe feature (a circle swept along a sketch path) on solidcore: SmApiCreatePipeSweep for one path segment, SmApiCreateSweepAlongPlanarPath of a circle normal to the path start for several. A tube of constant circular section has volume pi r^2 L exactly while its radius stays under the path's bend radius, so every expected volume is a closed form. Paths and diameters are the model's own: wiazka-bplus (diameter 2.7) runs w1..w5 in the plane y = 38.5 (line 8.352, quarter arc r 2.808, line 21.225, quarter arc r 2.808, line 134.384; its later segments leave the plane and are left out), przewod-wyjscie-plus (diameter 5.5) starts with the straight run w1 from (-1.4916, 11, 62.9879) to (17.0675, 11, 52.2771). The grommet case puts that 5.5 wire through a grommet bore (r 4.2, as a52-battery-shapes) in a stand-in 60 x 40 x 4 wall; the channel case cuts a 5.5 wire bent at r 10 through a stand-in 30 x 30 x 10 block (a cable channel). The model's other wires follow 3D spline paths, which SM_API cannot rebuild (it has no curve through points).
